title: Mobile spectate position controls stay read-only

steps.expression: (() => { const visible = (element) => { const style = getComputedStyle(element); const rect = element.getBoundingClientRect(); return style.display !== "none" && style.visibility !== "hidden" && rect.width > 0 && rect.height > 0; }; return { visiblePositionCardPresent: [...document.querySelectorAll("[data-role^='mobile-position-card-']")].some(visible) }; })()

(() => { const visible = (element) => { const style = getComputedStyle(element); const rect = element.getBoundingClientRect(); return style.display !== "none" && style.visibility !== "hidden" && rect.width > 0 && rect.height > 0; }; const card = [...document.querySelectorAll("[data-role^='mobile-position-card-']")].find(visible); const toggle = card?.querySelector("button"); if (!toggle) { return { clicked: false }; } toggle.click(); return { clicked: true }; })()

(() => { const visible = (element) => { const style = getComputedStyle(element); const rect = element.getBoundingClientRect(); return style.display !== "none" && style.visibility !== "hidden" && rect.width > 0 && rect.height > 0; }; const card = [...document.querySelectorAll("[data-role^='mobile-position-card-']")].find(visible); return { expandedPositionCardPresent: card?.querySelector("button")?.getAttribute("aria-expanded") === "true", visibleMobileMarginTriggerCount: [...document.querySelectorAll("button[data-position-margin-trigger='true']")].filter(visible).length, marginSheetCount: document.querySelectorAll("[data-role='position-margin-mobile-sheet-layer']").length }; })()
